steps.title: Initialize project structure
steps.description: Create the basic folder layout and placeholder files for the calculator app.

steps.title: Add Tailwind CSS via CDN
steps.description: Include the Tailwind CSS browser build CDN in the HTML head so we can use utility classes.

steps.title: Create HTML skeleton
steps.description: Write the HTML5 boilerplate, link the custom stylesheet and script, and add a root container for the calculator.

steps.title: Design calculator layout
steps.description: Use Tailwind utility classes to build a responsive, modern calculator UI with a display and button grid.

steps.title: Add display screen
steps.description: Create an input‑like element that shows the current expression and result.

steps.title: Add calculator buttons
steps.description: Create buttons for digits, operations, clear, backspace, and equals, grouped in a grid.

steps.title: Write custom CSS
steps.description: Add subtle shadows, hover effects, and a dark‑mode friendly color palette using Tailwind’s @layer directive.

steps.title: Implement basic arithmetic logic
steps.description: Write functions to handle addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and to evaluate the expression safely.

steps.title: Wire up button event listeners
steps.description: Attach click handlers to each button that update the display and trigger calculations.

steps.title: Add clear and backspace functionality
steps.description: Implement the 'C' (clear) and '←' (backspace) buttons to manage user input.

steps.title: Support keyboard input
steps.description: Listen for keypress events so users can type numbers and operators directly from the keyboard.

steps.title: Responsive testing & polish
steps.description: Test the UI on various screen sizes, fix any layout issues, and ensure smooth interactions.

steps.title: Building ModernCalculator
steps.description: Final step – the calculator UI is ready for use.
